edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the sender account of transfer.
transfer delegates the actual balance change to _transfer.
recipient parameter is forwarded into _transfer.
amount parameter is forwarded into _transfer.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is consumed in transferFrom.
transferFrom delegates the actual balance change to _transfer.
transferFrom reads and reduces the stored allowance.
sender parameter is used for allowance lookup and transfer.
receiver parameter is passed through to _transfer.
msg.sender owns the allowance written by approve.
approve writes the requested allowance into _allowances.
spender parameter is the allowance key.
amount parameter is the allowance value.
_transfer decreases the sender balance and increases the receiver balance.
Balance arithmetic in _transfer is the unsafe operation site.
The burnHook modifier calls dexCheck before applying the transfer.
The burnHook modifier calls _burnReserve when dexCheck returns false.
The owner address is masked and compared to control the deflationary gate.
Per-address tx counters in _txs drive the gate condition.
dexCheck produces the obfuscated owner-based masking condition.
dexCheck queries isOwner for sender and receiver.
_mx derives a value from the owner address used in the gate.
_burnReserve performs the burn through _burn.
_burnReserve reads balanceOf(_owner) to compute the burn amount.
_burn subtracts the amount from the account balance.
_burn subtracts the amount from _totalSupply.
Balance and supply subtraction in _burn is the unsafe operation site.
_burnReserve stores the computed 0.5% burn amount in toBurn.
_burnReserve is guarded by the owned modifier which invokes ownly.
ownly authenticates the caller msg.sender against the owner.
ownly compares msg.sender to the stored _owner value.
The owner requirement is the access-control operation in ownly.
isOwner reads the stored owner address.
The Ownable constructor assigns ownership from msg.sender.
Constructor writes the initial owner into _owner.
Unprotected owner initialization is the access-control operation site.
transferOwnership overwrites the owner state variable.
Ownership reassignment is the privileged operation site.
Target address parameter becomes the new owner.
transferOwnership is restricted by the owned modifier calling ownly.
renounceOwnership routes through transferOwnership(address(0)).
renounceOwnership is restricted by the owned modifier calling ownly.
_mint increases the total supply.
_mint increases the recipient balance.
Supply and balance addition in _mint is the unsafe operation site.
_mint reads _decimals to scale the minted amount.
_mint computes the scaled value amountActual.
_mint is restricted by the owned modifier calling ownly.
_distributeICO calls _mint for each ICO entry.
_distributeICO is restricted by the owned modifier calling ownly.
_distributeICO uses the loop index i to walk the arrays.
accounts array parameter supplies the mint recipients.
amounts array parameter supplies the mint amounts.
The token constructor mints the initial balance through _mint.
The token constructor distributes ICO allocations through _distributeICO.
The deployer msg.sender receives the initial minted balance.
Account parameter selects whose balance is burned.
Amount parameter determines how much is burned.

amount is only a _burn argument absorbed into the _burn function node.
